messages:
maria: Quick proposal — two-week 'Welcome Spiral' for new signups around the launch. Goal: educate, surface benchmark proof points, invite to webinar on day 10, and route high-engagers to SDRs. Draft cadence below, need +1s on segments & subjects.

kevin: Love it. Cadence looks good. Suggest testing 2 subject lines per email. Draft examples: 
```
Day 0: Welcome — 'Welcome to Redwood Inference' | 'Get started — free credits & quickstart'
Day 2: Benchmark story — 'How Acme cut gen cost 3x' | 'See cost & latency wins in production'
Day 5: How-to + best practices — 'Lower token cost without losing quality' | 'Optimize prompts for cost & speed'
Day 10: Webinar invite — 'Join live: Building production LLM apps' | 'Live: Real-world inference benchmarks'
Day 12: Final nudge + SDR opt-in — 'Want a walkthrough?' | 'Book a 15-minute intro'
```

ashley: For segments — base by team_size + early usage signal (api_calls > 10 in first 48h), and intent tag if they hit embeddings endpoint. Also add `company_tier` for enterprise vs startup routing.

jon: For routing: if user opens >=3 emails and clicks webinar link -> tag as `hot` and assign to SDR queue A. If clicks pricing or docs -> SDR queue B. Need the exact event property names from eng so automations are reliable.

kevin: Also recommend adding a lightweight survey in the day 5 email (single question) to capture primary use-case (chat, search, retrieval). That helps personalize day 10 webinar invite and benchmark narratives.

sam: I'll build the segment SQL: `where created_at > now() - interval '14 days' and (api_calls > 10 or embedding_calls > 0)` and set webhook to `/sdr/assign`. Who owns SDR mapping?

maria: @sam please own the webhook. @ashley please confirm segment filters tonight. @kevin can you finalize A/B subject pairs by EOD? I'll update the campaign handbook with cadence and content slots.

marketing-bot: Scheduled send preview created for cohort `alpha` on 2025-04-11 09:00 PST. Preview link: https://console.redwood.ai/campaigns/preview/alpha

ashley: Confirmed filters, added `team_size` buckets and `company_tier`. Also added a content variation for enterprise vs startup (shorter, CTA->AE).

jon: Small ask — can we insert a benchmark stat card in day 2 email (PNG + alt text)? Alt should read 'Redwood inference reduced token cost by up to 3x in real workloads'. Ops to provide image asset.

maria: Noted. ops, can you deliver the card by tomorrow 3pm PST? If not, we'll use a text pull-quote instead.

sam: Webhook ready, will deploy to staging tonight. SDR mapping: opens+clicks -> queue A, pricing clicks -> queue B, enterprise signals -> rep assignment field.

kevin: I'll prepare the copy grid and send to reviewers. Reviewers: @maria @ashley @jon — expect in ~2 hours.

maria: Thanks team. Quick check: do we suppress sends to users in EMEA outside of 08:00-10:00 local time? Reply yes/no.

ashley: yes, please schedule by local timezone windows.

jon: yes + add PST/UTC fallback window for missing timezone data.

maria: Perfect — wrapping up. I'll post final draft in #marketing-drafts at 2025-04-09 16:00 PST. :rocket:
